Widget API

Widgets are created with POST /v1/widgets. The response includes an id.

Limits

  • Each account may create 250 widgets per day.
  • Widget names are limited to 80 characters.

Pricing

PlanPrice
Free$0
Growth$49

Example

{"name": "signup", "color": "blue"}
